field_edits.updated_text: No focal acute osseous abnormality or marrow edema. No acute fracture, dislocation, or marrow-replacing lesion.
Minimal knee joint effusion. Knee joint alignment is maintained.
Minimal extrusion of the medial meniscus beyond the tibial margin. The meniscus otherwise appears intact.
Minimal extrusion of the lateral meniscus beyond the tibial margin. The meniscus otherwise appears intact.
Diffuse bulky mucoid/intrasubstance degeneration with sprain of the ACL, fibers remain continuous. The ACL appears intact.
Mildly bulky heterogeneous signal consistent with PCL sprain/degenerative change, fibers remain continuous. The PCL appears intact.

Near full-thickness tear of the distal quadriceps tendon just proximal to its patellar insertion at the superior pole of the patella with surrounding soft‑tissue edema. Patellar tendon shows focal increased STIR signal at its patellar insertion consistent with insertional sprain and mild adjacent edema. Quadriceps and patellar tendons otherwise maintain continuity.
Soft‑tissue edema/injury anteriorly around the distal quadriceps tendon and superior aspect of the patella. No mass or fluid collection.

impression:
1. Near full-thickness tear of the distal quadriceps tendon just proximal to its patellar insertion with surrounding soft‑tissue edema.
2. Insertional sprain of the patellar tendon with mild adjacent soft‑tissue edema.
3. Diffuse mucoid/intrasubstance degeneration with sprain of the ACL, fibers remain continuous.
4. Mild bulky heterogeneous PCL sprain/degenerative change with maintained fiber continuity.
5. Minimal extrusion of both medial and lateral menisci without definite tear.
6. Minimal knee joint effusion.
